mug.name: Speckled mug
mug.description: A sturdy, well-balanced mug in an oat glaze with fine iron speckles. The wide handle fits three fingers.

dripper.name: Celadon pour-over
dripper.description: A pour-over dripper for size 2 paper filters, with ribs inside for an even flow. Glazed in a pale celadon green.

bowl.name: Iron-red serving bowl
bowl.description: A wide, shallow bowl for salads, pasta or fruit. The glaze breaks to a dark brown at the rim.
